description.value: The Nechako Branch is one of two public library locations operated by the Prince George Public Library, serving the Hart neighbourhood of Prince George in BC's Central Interior. Situated entirely on one level with full wheelchair accessibility, it offers free public internet and computer access alongside a broad collection of physical and digital resources. For touring cyclists on the Hart Highway corridor, it provides a free, welcoming stop for connectivity and a rest from the road.

address.value: 6547 Hart Highway, Prince George, BC V2K 3A4

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms this is an active branch of the Prince George Public Library, with the Nechako Branch consistently listed at '6547 Hart Highway' — contradicting OSM's 'Hazel Drive,' which appears to be incorrect. The OSM internet_access=wlan tag is corroborated by the website's 'Internet, Computers & Printing' public service and a guide for accessing internet and computers at branches. No explicit mention of bike parking, washrooms, or other cyclist-specific amenities appears for the Nechako Branch in the available website content.
concerns: Address discrepancy: OSM lists '6547 Hazel Drive' but the website consistently shows '6547 Hart Highway' for the Nechako Branch — OSM street name appears incorrect; address updated to website value.
OSM website URL (https://www.pgpl.ca/hours-and-information) returns a 404 page; corrected to main library website https://www.pgpl.ca.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, active public library branch with confirmed internet access; a publicly accessible facility with utility for touring cyclists seeking connectivity or a rest stop in Prince George.
